Topics covered in this PDF

BRL-108 (Retail Operations and Store Management) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Consumer buying behaviour, store site selection, store layout and design, high and low involvement products, the retail promotional mix
  • The Balanced Scorecard, retail pricing strategies, customer retention and loyalty, merchandise planning, category management and human resources

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: attempt all questions, maximum marks 100, coverage all blocks, assignment code BRL-108/TMA/2026-27. Part A: seven short type questions of 10 marks each. Part B: two essay type questions of 15 marks each

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.

This PDF is study and reference material. Use it like this:

  • Learn the answer structure from the PDF: introduction, concept or facts, examples and conclusion
  • Write your final answer in your own words. The university alone evaluates it
